summary: Profusa, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an additional closing under an existing securities purchase agreement, issuing a senior secured convertible promissory note with $300,000 purchase price and $329,670.33 principal, reflecting original issue discount. The note bears 7% interest, matures September 1, 2027, and converts at $4.28 per share with a floor price of $1.07, subject to adjustment. Monthly amortization starts January 1, 2027, and mandatory prepayment of 33% of net proceeds from subsequent offerings is required. This is routine financing, not a special situation; no strategic event or structural change is present.
